checks.name: replay costs 0 disk writes and 0 log_writes
ENOENT refusal costs 0 disk writes (nothing logged)
APPEND within a block: disk writes == 2*L+2 (L=3: log copy + header + install + header clear)
APPEND within a block: L <= MAXOPBLOCKS(10)
APPEND crossing 1 KB boundary (edge.txt): disk writes == 2*L+2 (L=5: log copy + header + install + header clear)
APPEND crossing 1 KB boundary (edge.txt): L <= MAXOPBLOCKS(10)
APPEND direct->indirect (big.txt): disk writes == 2*L+2 (L=6: log copy + header + install + header clear)
CREATE new file: disk writes == 2*L+2 (L=6: log copy + header + install + header clear)

notes: The table block is exactly ONE of the L logged blocks, i.e. the exactly-once record costs +1 log block = +2 disk writes per executed effect; a replay costs nothing.
